title: Native boot launcher pin can be unreachable from the available provider root
body: The paired native-boot witness failed closed before build because Undertow's launcher pin 79b3dcfe7f0b0e64bc0bbf1e5bd44a9799534a0b was unreachable from the available /home/liory/projects/UndersetLauncher checkout at 2f54417712f2bba29ca714d4aef25759a49ea082. To exercise the lane, the scratch Undertow worktree had to temporarily use the locally available launcher HEAD and a separate scratch cache. The provider setup should provision the exact pinned launcher or expose a supported immutable pin-worktree route without editing the consumer pin.
